tei:div.tei:p: "!#ྈ 'chi med klong gsal rdo rje'i srog sgrub las: tshe'i las byang dgos 'dod kun 'byung bzhugs:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ 'chi med tshe'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: 'chi med klong gsal rdo rje srog sgrub las: tshe yi las byang dgos 'dod kun 'byung bstan: dpal ldan sangs rgyas kun gyi mdzod 'dzin pa: bla med gsang ba kun gyi gter gcig pu: 'khrul med nam mkha'i mdzod kyi sgo brgya 'byed: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de yang byin che nyams dga' bag ldan zhing: bkra shis dben par stegs bu mda' gang ba: bla gtor brang gzugs pad 'dab bzhi tshe ril: dbus su bum pa rgyan ldan bkod pa'i mtha': man ngag lhan du dkyil 'khor bkod mdzes bsham: skyabs sems bka' bsgo mtshams gcad byin rlabs dang: gzhal yas lha bskyed spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag: mchod 'bul bstod pa bya zhing tshogs mchod 'bul: lhag mchod chad tho brtan skyong bsdu chog dang: bkra shis smon lam mjug bsdu las rim mo: dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni: na mo: 'gro ba'i dpal mgon bcom ldan tshe dpag med: thugs rje'i bdag nyid tshe lha rigs lnga'i tshogs: 'di gzung bla med byang chub ma 'thob bar: bdag sogs 'gro kun gus pas skyabs su mchi: lan gsum/ gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni: hrī: mkha' khyab 'gro ba dus min du: 'chi ba'i 'jigs las legs sgrol ba'i: 'chi med lha tshogs bsgrubs nas kyang: 'gro ba skyob par sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ gsum pa bgegs gtor ni: a mṛta sa bsang*/ swa bhā ba sa sbyang*/ hrī: nga ni pad+ma dbang gi sku: bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i dpa' bo'i sku: tshe rku srog la 'jab pa'i gdon: nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren rnams: glud gtor dam pa 'di khyer la: myur ba nyid du phyir dengs shig: gang dag mi 'gro 'dug gyur na: 'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus kyi: mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas 'gyur: pad+ma kro ta log 'dren 'byung po u tsa ta ya phaṭa: hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad: bzhi pa mtshams gcod srung 'khor ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid dbang chen thugs ka nas:

sprul pa'i pho nya grangs med 'phros: steng 'og mtshon cha'i drwa bas gtams: bgegs tshogs ma lus mtshams bcad do: dzñā na badz+ra rak+ṣa hūm̐: byin 'beb: hrī: sku lnga ye shes mnga' bdag bcom ldan 'das: tshe lha rigs lnga rang bzhin gnas nas bzhengs: dkyil 'khor byin phob mchod rdzas gzi byin skyed: sgrub mchog rnal 'byor bdag la dbang bzhi skur: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥdzñā na badz+ra ā be sha ya a ā: lnga pa mchod pa byin rlabs ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: mchod rdzas nyes skyon ma dag dngos 'dzin sbyangs: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsregs gtor sbyangs spel bsgyur: 'dod yon zag med ye shes mchod pa'i sprin: rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs su byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: sman gtor rak+ta mkha' dbyings khyab: zag med mchod sprin nam mkha' mdzod: rang bzhin dag pa'i bdud rtsir gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dzo ba liṃ ta bha la ba te sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: lan gsum/ de ni sngon 'gro'i rim pa'o: de nas dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni: dang po ting nge 'dzin gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni: hrī: snang stong chen po'i cho 'phrul las: shes rab yum lnga'i mkha' klong du: rang rig skye med blo 'das pa'i: 'ja' tshon lta bu'i ting 'dzin bsgom: ā: rang rig gsal ba'i 'od lam las: hrīḥyig dmar po 'od zer 'phros: nam mkha'i klong du 'ja' ltar shar: de las 'od 'phros 'byung rim brtsegs: e yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ keṃ bh+rūm̐: 'byung ba chen po lnga ru shar: ye shes lnga ldan gzhal yas khang: gru bzhi sgo bzhi mtshan nyid ldan: phyi nang dri med 'od klong du: yongs rdzogs rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor shar:

bh+rūm̐ dzñā na tsakra maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐: gnyis pa lha bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: rang rig lhun grub dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus: rgyu yi yi ge hrīḥdamar 'phro 'du las: rang mdangs 'od rtsal rang rig tshe dpag med: snang stong dri bral dmar gsal longs sku'i tshul: rin chen prog zhu snyan rgyan mgul rgyan mdzes: phyag gdub zhabs gdub dar dang rin chen spras: phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag 'chi med bcud bum 'dzin: skyil krung pang du gsang ba ye shes dmar: gcer mo rus rgyan tshe bum mda' dar 'dzin: bde ba'i nyams ldan yab kyi sku la 'khril: phyogs bzhi pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i gdan steng du: dbus mdun bud+dha tshe lha sku mdog mthing: g.yas pa mda' dar g.yon pa tshe bum 'dzin: longs spyod rdzogs sku dbyings phyug yum dang sbyor: shar phyogs badz+ra tshe lha sku mdog dkar: g.yas pa mda' dar g.yon pa tshe bum 'dzin: longs spyod rdzogs sku mā kī yum dang sbyor: lho ru rat+na tshe lha sku mdog ser: g.yas pa mda' dar g.yon pa tshe bum 'dzin: longs spyod rdzogs sku spyan ma yum dang sbyor: nub tu pad+ma tshe lha sku mdog dmar: g.yas pa mda' dar g.yon pa tshe bum 'dzin: longs spyod rdzogs sku gos dkar yum dang sbyor: byang du karma tshe lha sku mdog ljang: g.yas pa mda' dar g.yon pa tshe bum 'dzin: longs spyod rdzogs sku sgrol ma yum dang sbyor: kun kyang snang stong dri bral longs sku'i tshul: skyil krung pang du rang 'od yum dang bcas: g.yas pa rang rtags g.yon pa tshe bum 'dzin: gnyis med 'khril sbyor bde ba'i nyams ldan zhing: phyi rol sgo mtshams sgo skyong rnam bzhi ni: dkar ser dmar ljang las mdog zer 'od can: phyag g.yas lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril: g.yon pa tshe bum rin chen du mas spras: phyed skyil 'dzum ldan 'od klong gsal 'tsher 'bar: steng 'og bar khyams bla ma yi dam dang: ḍā ki chos srung bka' sdod pho nyar bcas:

nyi ltar gsal zhing zer ltar dwangs pa yi: gnas gsum oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ mthing las: 'od 'phros bde ba can dang rnga yab gling: rab 'byams dag pa'i zhing gi tshe lha rnams: nyi zer rdul ltar spyan 'dren zhing 'dir dza: badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdza: gsum pa spyan 'dren pa ni: hrī: 'og min bde chen dbang gi zhing khams nas: 'gro ba kun la gzigs pa'i thugs rje can: tshe bdag bcom ldan rigs lnga yab yum bcas: byin dbab dbang bskur stsol phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: mgyogs ma bzhi sogs tshe yi pho nya mo: ḍā ki chos srung bka' sdod dam can sogs: mi mngon dbyings nas thugs dam gnas 'dir skul: gzhom bral 'chi med stsol phyir spyan 'dren no: oṃ a mā ra ṇa dzī ban+ti ye oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: ā yuḥsid+dhi sa ma ya dzaḥdza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: bzhi pa dam ye dbyer med du bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hrī: rang snang 'od gsal lhun grub gzhal yas su: bde gshegs tshe lha rigs lnga'i lha tshogs rnams: dam ye dbyer med skyon bral pad+ma'i steng: dgyes shing mi g.yo brtan par bzhugs su gsol: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: lnga pa phyag 'tshal ba ni: hrī: chos sku 'gyur med rang bzhin lhun grub las: longs sku'i rtsal mdangs mgon po 'od dpag med: thugs rje'i sprul bsgyur tshe bdag rigs lnga'i tshogs: bdag sogs lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: na mo pu ru sha ya ho: drug pa phyi mchod ni: hrī: chu gtsang yid 'ong sman mchog mchod yon dang: mdzes pa'i me tog dri zhim ngad ldan spos: mdangs gsal mar me dri bzang ngad ldan chab: ro brgya'i zhal zas rol mo dbyangs snyan ldan: bde gshegs tshe lha rigs lnga'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes nas 'chi med tshe dbang dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da 'i bar brjod: nang mchod ni: hrī: snod bcud rnam dag bde chen 'od du 'bar: tshogs drug dbang po'i zhing khams rab tu bkra: bde gshegs 'chi med rigs lnga'i tshogs la 'bul:

bzhes nas 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: badz+ra rū pa shab+da gan+dhe ra sa spar+she pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye swā hā: sman mchod ni: hrī: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman: dug lnga rnam par dag pa'i rdzas: ro mchog brgya ldan bdud rtsi 'di: 'chi med lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: sarba pañtsa a mṛta la kha raṃ khā hi: rak+ta'i mchod pa ni: hrī: nyon mongs gzung 'dzin bsgral pa'i khrag: 'dod chags rnam par dag pa'i rdzas: rgyud drug 'khor ba bsgral phyir 'bul: bzhes nas tshe dbang dngos grub stsol: ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: gtor mchod ni: hrī: snod kyi 'jig rten gtor gzhong du: bcud kyi skye 'gro gtor mar sbyangs: 'chi med tshe yi lha la 'bul: bzhes nas tshe dbang dngos grub stsol: ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi: bdun pa bstod pa ni: hrī: chos dbyings ngang nas rang byung skur ston pa: gsang ba ye shes lha mo yum dang sbyor: 'gro ba kun la thugs rje chags pa'i mdangs: mgon po tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod: mdangs rtsal ye shes lnga yi rol pa las: sku lnga'i bdag nyid bcom ldan tshe dpag med: 'byung lngar dbang sgyur rang rang yum dang 'khril: tshe lha rigs lnga'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: sgo skyong las mdog tshe yi lha mo bzhi: steng 'og phyogs mtshams bla tshe yar pa rnams: rang bzhin dbyings su sdud pa'i pho nya mo: lha mo sgo ma bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod: ye nas ye shes rang la bzhugs pa la: ma rtogs a 'thas mtshan mar bzung ba'i blo: chos kun sgyu ma tsam du gnas pa'i ngang: rang rig don gyi lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: dzap bskul ni: hrī: rtag chad mtha' grol dkyil 'khor 'dir: ma rtogs gnyis 'dzin blo bzo spangs: rig pa sku lnga'i bdag nyid can: zang thal sgrib g.yogs med pa'i ngang: dzap kyis sku gsung gnad nas bskul: spros pas rgyal ba mchod pas mnyes: bsdus pas tshe bsod mnga' thang bskyed:

lha nyid rang la rang nyid lha: dbyer med ngo bo nyid du lta: ma 'grub bar du bsgrub la 'bad: srog gi phyir yang mi gtong ngo: thugs rje thugs dam dbyings nas skul: rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol: oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī ban+ti ye swā hā: snying po'o: sham bu ni: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥm ma dzñā na ā yu ṣe puṇ+ye sid+dhi tshe bh+rūm̐ nṛḥdza: thun mtshams tshe 'gugs bya ba ni: mda' dar tshad bzhag gdon bgegs bskrad: mda' dar g.yab cing 'di ltar 'bad: hrīḥm: nub phyogs bde chen lnga ldan dag pa'i zhing: gar gyi dbang phyug mgon po tshe dpag med: 'gro ba kun la thugs rjes mnyam par gzigs: thugs dam thugs rjes dbyings nas skur bzhengs la: sgrub rdzas dkyil 'khor gnyan la byin chen phob: bdag sogs mched lcam sgrub po'i tshe srog srings: srog rten tshe mda' 'di la tshad cig phob: 'chi med rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol: hrī: dbus phyogs bde chen bud+dha tshe dpag med: chos dbyings klong nas thugs dam skur bzhengs la: gsang ba ye shes 'chi med tshe'i lha mos: sems kyi khams nas bla tshe yar pa rnams: nam mkha'i khams nas tshe yi bcud sdus la: sgrub rdzas dkyil 'khor gnyan la byin chen phob: bdag sogs mched lcam sgrub po'i tshe srog srings: srog rten tshe mda' 'di la tshad cig phob: 'chi med rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol: hrī: shar phyogs bde chen badz+ra tshe dpag med: me long klong nas thugs dam skur bzhengs la: khrag gi khams nas bla tshe yar pa rnams: chu yi khams nas tshe yi bcud sdus la: sgrub rdzas dkyil 'khor gnyan la byin chen phob: bdag sogs mched lcam sgrub po'i tshe srog srings: srog rten tshe mda' 'di la tshad cig phob: 'chi med rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol: hrī: lho phyogs bde chen rat+na tshe dpag med: mnyam nyid klong nas thugs dam skur bzhengs la: sha yi khams nas bla tshe yar pa rnams:

sa yi khams nas tshe yi bcud sdus la: sgrub rdzas dkyil 'khor gnyan la byin chen phob: bdag sogs mched lcam sgrub po'i tshe srog srings: srog rten tshe mda' 'di la tshad cig phob: 'chi med rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol: hrī: nub phyogs bde chen pad+ma tshe dpag med: sor rtog klong nas thugs dam skur bzhengs la: drod kyi khams nas bla tshe yar pa rnams: me yi khams nas tshe yi bcud sdus la: sgrub rdzas dkyil 'khor gnyan la byin chen phob: bdag sogs mched lcam sgrub po'i tshe srog srings: srog rten tshe mda' 'di la tshad cig phob: 'chi med rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol: hrī: byang phyogs bde chen karma tshe dpag med: bya grub klong nas thugs dam skur bzhengs la: dbugs kyi khams nas bla tshe yar pa rnams: rlung gi khams nas tshe yi bcud sdus la: sgrub rdzas dkyil 'khor gnyan la byin chen phob: bdag sogs mched lcam sgrub po'i tshe srog srings: srog rten tshe mda' 'di la tshad cig phob: 'chi med rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol: hrī: phyogs mtshams lha mo sgo ma rnam pa bzhi: tshad med bzhi yi ngang las skur bzhengs la: 'byung bzhi'i khams nas bla tshe yar pa rnams: phrin las rnam bzhi'i ngang las tshe bcud sdus: sgrub rdzas dkyil 'khor gnyan la byin chen phob: bdag sogs mched lcam sgrub po'i tshe srog srings: srog rten tshe mda' 'di la tshad cig phob: 'chi med rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol: hrī: 'chi med tshe lha rigs lnga thugs dam can: yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can byin rlabs can: chos srung gter bdag pho nya nus pa can: byin rlabs thugs rje'i sprin phung khrigs se khrig: dngos grub sbrang char bzhin du shar ra ra: thugs rje'i mthu stobs gzi mdangs yal la la: gnyis 'dzin gdon bgegs bar chad sangs se sang: bde drod nyams dang rtogs pa 'ur ru ru: dkyil 'khor gzhal yas 'di la byin chen phob:

sgrub mchog rnal 'byor rnams la dbang bzhi skur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad zhi ba dang: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī ban+ti ye swā hā: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: ma ma ā yuḥdzñā na puṇ+ye sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: gnad dam bskul zhing byin rlabs bsdus: de nas rjes kyi las khrigs ni: dang por tshogs 'khor byin rlabs ni: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐: tshogs rdzas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: ma dag dngos 'dzin stong par sbyangs: 'dod yon phun tshogs ro brgya'i zas: mi zad 'dod rgu'i rgya mtshor gyur: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa ni: hrī: 'og min bde ba can dang ni: lnga ldan rigs lnga'i zhing khams nas: bcom ldan tshe yi lha tshogs rnams: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dbu skra thor tshugs ldems se ldem: dar dpyang cod pan pur ru ru: snyan rgyan mgul rgyan khrol lo lo: phyag gdub zhabs gdub sil li li: dkyil 'khor 'di la byin chen phob: tshogs gtor 'di la bcud cig phob: sgrub mchog rnal 'byor thams cad la: tshe dang dbang gi dngos grub stsol: badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdza: tshogs phud rim gyis bkye ste: dang po phud mchod ni:

hrī: 'chi med tshe yi lha tshogs rnams: 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes: 'bad rtsol med pa rdo rje'i tshe: deng 'dir sgrub mchog rnams la stsol: ga ṇa tsakra pū dza ho: bar pa bshags pa ni: hrī: bdag sogs ma rig lus ngag sems: bag med nyes skyon ci mchis pa: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la bshags: dri bral tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya bi shud+dhe ā: tha ma bsgral bstab ni: hūm̐: nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa rnams: bdag med rdo rje phur pas bsgral: rnam shes chos dbyings klong du phaṭa: phung po sha khrag tshogs su 'bul: hrī: nyon mongs gzung 'dzin bsgral pa yi: sha khrag don snying dbang por bcas: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: 'khor 'das gnyis med ngang du rol: ma hā sarba pū dza ho: gnyis pa lhag ma ni: rme lhag bsdus la gtsang lhag btab ste bdud rtsir byin gyis brlab: hrī: 'chi med tshe yi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi: bran dang pho nya bka' nyan ma lus pa: tha tshig bzhin du bka' yi pham 'bab longs: rkyen zlogs dgra thul sngags kyi bstan pa srungs: uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣe bh+yaḥswā hā: gsum pa thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: bzhengs shig bzhengs shig stobs bcu mnga' ba'i lha: sems can don la dgongs pa'i tshe dpag med: dus la mi 'da' thugs rje'i skur bzhengs la: rig 'dzin 'dus par byin rlabs char chen phob: bla tshe nyams gsos brtan g.yo'i tshe bcud stims: sgrub pa'i las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: bzhi pa chad tho bsgrag pa ni: hrī: sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa'i dang po la: 'og min gsang chen bde chen rol pa yi: bcom ldan mgon po snang ba mtha' yas kyis: 'chi med tshe yi dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe: ye shes dbyings kyi srung ma thams cad kyis: tshe la rku ba'i bar chad zlog pa dang: sgrub mchog sku tshe sring bar ma chad dam: tha tshig thugs dam bzhin du phrin las mdzod:

de 'og bar gyi bskal pa'i dbus ma la: zla gam dbang phug rā ga rak+ta ru: rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma saṃ bha dang: las kyi gzungs ma man+dā ra ba yis: 'chi med tshe yi dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho yis: tshe la rku ba'i bar chad zlog pa dang: sgrub mchog sku tshe sring bar ma chad dam: tha tshig thugs dam bzhin du phrin las mdzod: de 'og tha yi bskal pa'i tha ma la: g.ya' ma lung dang sgrags kyi yang rdzong du: slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang: shes rab yum chen mkhar chen mtsho rgyal ma: slob ma'i dwangs ma rgyal ba mchog dbyangs bcas: 'chi med tshe yi dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe: tshe bdag bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho yis: tshe la rku ba'i bar chad zlog pa dang: sgrub mchog sku tshe sring bar ma chad dam: tha tshig thugs dam bzhin du phrin las mdzod: de 'og yang mtha' dus la babs pa'i tshe: yang rdzong drag sngags gsang ba'i phug pa ru: rig 'dzin sngags 'chang gar dbang las rab rtsal: shes rab lha mo ye shes 'od 'bar bcas: dgongs brgyud tshe yi dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe: bka' dang gter srung dam can rgya mtsho yis: tshe la rku ba'i bar chad zlog pa dang: sgrub mchog sku tshe sring bar ma chad dam: tha tshig thugs dam bzhin du phrin las mdzod: ces gtor ma sgrub khang steng du 'bul: lnga pa gtor gzhong bshal chus brtan ma bskyang ba ni: bh+yo: slob dpon chen po pad+ma la sogs pa: rgyal ba rnams kyi bka' srung bstan srung zhing: ma sring brtan ma chen mo bcu gnyis rnams: lhab lhub sil snyan sgra bcas gnas 'dir byon: mchod gtor bzhes la tha tshig phrin las mdzod: ma ma sring 'gro ma ba liṃ ta khā hi: drug pa rta bro ni: hrī: srid gsum 'bar ba'i hom khung du: tshe rku srog la 'jab pa'i gdon: mnan no dmigs med mkha' dbyings rgya: theg pa rim dgu'i rgyas gdab bo: bdun pa dbang blang ba ni: hrī: bde gshegs tshe lha rigs lnga'i lha tshogs rnams:

chos kyi dbyings nas thugs dam skur bzhengs la: bdag la brtser dgongs tshe dbang dngos grub stsol: 'chi med tshe dang 'dzad med zas nor gos: re skong yon tan 'gro 'dul phrin las dbang: da lta nyid du bdag la bstsal du gsol: ces gsol ba gdab: hrī: sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku: ngang nyid rdo rje chos dbyings las: 'bar ba'i tshe lha rigs lnga'i tshogs: sku yi dbyings su dbang bskur ro: oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī ban+ti ye kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: hrī: sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes gsung: ngang nyid rdo rje chos dbyings las: 'bar ba'i tshe lha rigs lnga'i tshogs: gsung gi dbyings su dbang bskur ro: oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī ban+ti ye wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: hrī: sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes thugs: ngang nyid rdo rje chos dbyings las: 'bar ba'i tshe lha rigs lnga'i tshogs: thugs kyi dbyings su dbang bskur ro: oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī ban+ti ye tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hrī: sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs: ngang nyid rdo rje chos dbyings las: 'bar ba'i tshe lha rigs lnga'i tshogs: sku gsung thugs su rgyas gdab bo: oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī ban+ti ye oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: bum pa bdud rtsi tshe ril mda' dar gnas su bskur: tshe'i rdzas rnams myang: brgyad pa bzod gsol ni: hrī: 'chi med dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: mchod pa ma 'byor mi gtsang nyams: bzlas brjod ma dag cho ga chad: ting 'dzin bying rmugs g.yeng la sogs: 'gal 'khrul nyes tshogs bzod par gsol: yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bskang: dgu pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: hrī: rang byung rang shar tshe lha rigs lnga'i lha: dmigs med rang grol klong du sa mā dhi: slar yang skye med dbyings kyi ngang nyid las: rjes thob gnyug ma'i tshe lha rigs lngar ldang: bcu pa bsngo ba ni: ho: dge ba 'di yis tshe rabs thams cad kyi: rnam dkar dge tshogs ma lus ji snyed rnams:

'gro kun 'chi med rig 'dzin 'thob phyir bsngo: 'khor gsum yongs dag 'dzin med chen por a: bcu gcig pa smon lam ni: hrī: bdag gzhan 'di nas skye tshe thams cad du: dal 'byor mchog thob rigs gtsang blo gros ldan: sku lnga lhun grub ye shes lnga rdzogs nas: tshe ring nad med bde skyid dpal thob shog: bcu gnyis pa bkra shis ni: hūm̐: bla ma'i byin rlabs thibs se thib: brgyud 'dzin smin grol bkra shis shog: yi dam dngos grub shar ra ra: nyams rtogs rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog: mkha' 'gro'i sprin phung khrigs se khrig: rlung sems dbang thob bkra shis shog: chos skyong mthu stobs khyugs se khyug: bar gcod zlog pa'i bkra shis shog: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i srog rtsa 'grub: rdzogs pa chen po'i bkra shis shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e ma rdo rje'i srog sgrub 'di: tshe sgrub kun gyi yang snying yin: mang du spel ba blos ma lcogs: da lta ma spel dbyings su sbos: ma 'ongs dus kyi tha ma la: mi rnams tshe thung longs spyod dbul: dus min 'chi ba glo bur 'byung: de tshe rdo rje'i srog sgrub 'di: skal ldan las can skyes bus spel: mang la ma 'chal brda tshem ldan: nyung la ma chad don dang ldan: 'gro ba blo yi yul dang bstun: las kyi rgya rtags dbyings nas khrol: bka' 'di gza' bdud drag mos srungs: gsang ba'i phug tu a tham rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra o rgyan dri med gling pas sgrags kyi yang rdzong nas gdan drangs pa'o/// / 1$0000250 ྈ 'chi med klong gsal rdo rje'i srog sgrub las: tshe dbang 'gro 'dul 'chi med snying po bzhugs so:1$0000300 ྈྈྈྈྈྈ thugs dam 'chi med tshe yi lha la 'dud: bdag 'dra gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje yis: snyigs ma'i dus su 'gro ba bskyab pa'i phyir: sa steng ma lus rin chen gter gyis bkang: khyad par rin chen tshe yi sgrub pa'i skor:

mang la ma 'chal nyung la ma tshang med: rno myur byin che 'o ma'i mar lta bu: 'chi med klong gsal rdo rje'i srog sgrub bzhag: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gang zhig rjes 'jug 'gro ba'i don slad du: rtsa dbang 'gro 'dul 'chi med snying po bstan: de la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las: sngon 'gro stegs bu mda' gang gru bzhi pa: rdul tshon ras bris tshom bu skabs dang sbyar: dbus su khri steng rat+na'i bum pa dag: chu gtsang a mṛta dang dri bzang blugs: bum pa'i sum gnyis khengs par rgyan ldan bsham: g.yas su tshe ril g.yon du tshe chang dang: rgyab tu mchod gtor dang ni mda' dar bkod: mdun du las bzhi lhun grub 'brang rgyas dang: tshe nas sman raka mtha' skor nyer mchod bsham: dngos gzhi skyabs sems nas gzung bzlas pa'i bar: dkyil 'khor bya ba slob dpon bgyi 'os rnams: legs par grub rjes tshogs mchod thugs dam bskul: rjes rim slob ma gral 'khod khrus dri bkru: bgegs bskrad byin dbab dbang gi gnang ba zhu: dngos gzhi dbang dang rgyas gdab shis pa brjod: dang po khrus bum bdud rtsi 'khyil bar bskyed: lha dang gnyis med chu yis lus ngag bkru: ho: bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams kyi ye shes chus: skal ldan rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la: gnas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib nyes ltung rnams: bkru bar bgyid do byang zhing dag gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra a mṛta sogs dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐: de yis nyes ltung ma lus kun byang nas: dkyil 'khor 'jug pa'i skal ldan bu ru gyur: de la dwangs ba bskyed phyir lo rgyus brjod: bka' bsgo mtshams gcod srung ba'i gur phub la: slob ma rnams kyis dbang gi gnang ba zhu: kye: bla ma rigs 'dus sku lnga'i bdag nyid dgongs: bdag cag skal ldan mos pa'i bu rnams la: bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal ba rdo rje'i tshe: deng 'dir dbang bskur smin grol byin gyis rlobs:

zhes zhus slob ma lha ru bskyed: byin dbab tiṣ+ṭha badz+ras brtan par bya: de nas dngos gzhi dbang gi rim pa la: tshe 'gugs sngon du 'gro bas/ tshe yi bum pa spyi bo'i gtsug tu bzhag: hrī: bum pa ye shes 'od lnga'i gzhal yas khang: bum chu lnga ldan bde gshegs tshe dpag med: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku yi dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags dang*/ kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: bhan+dha'i bdud rtsi mgrin par bskur zhing: hrī: dung chen bde ba chen po'i snod nang du: rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman: 'chi med lha tshogs mnyam sbyor byang chub sems: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: 'gag med gsung gi tshe dbang thob par shog: rtsa sngags dang*/ wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: tshe ril snying gar bskur zhing: hrī: phyi ltar dam rdzas dkar mngar 'bar ba'i bcud: nang ltar rtsa gsum tshe lha rigs lnga'i lha: gnyis med dam rdzas myong grol ril bu 'di: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: 'khrul med thugs kyi tshe dbang thob par shog: rtsa sngags dang*/ tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: las bzhi'i 'brang rgyas lag tu gtad la: hrī: ye shes lha mo sgo ma rnam bzhi yi: phyag mtshan 'bar ba'i pho brang dam pa 'di: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: phrin las bzhi yi 'gro don mthar phyin shog: rtsa sngags dang*/ sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī: mda' dar gnas lngar rgyas gdab la: hrī: snod bcud 'byung lnga'i bcud bsdus pa'i: ye shes lnga yi phyag rgya yis: 'gyur ba med pa'i rgyas gdab pas: mi shigs mi 'gyur bh+rūm̐ nṛ rgya: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: me tog gtor la: hrī: chos dbyings 'gyur ba med pa'i sku: snang ba mtha' yas bkra shis shog: rang bzhin rtsal la mtshan dpe rdzogs: tshe lha rigs lnga'i bkra shis shog: byin rlabs dngos grub char ltar 'beb: bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog:

bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rab rgyal zhing: yi dam lha tshogs bkra shis shog: rtsa rlung thig le'i ngo bo nyid: ma dang mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis shog: gang la bsam pa'i don kun 'grub: nor lha gter bdag bkra shis shog: bar chad bdud dpung 'dul mdzad pa'i: chos skyong srung ma'i bkra shis shog: ces dang slob mas gtang rag gi: maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing dge ba bsngo: tha ma tshogs mchod dga' ston bya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e ma: dam pa'i srog thig yid bzhin nor bu 'di: kho mo dbyangs can mtsho rgyal bdag gis bkod: dbyings rig mi shigs rig pa'i sgrom du sbas: ma 'ongs dus kyi tha mar gyur pa'i tshe: rdo rje las rab rtsal gyis spyod par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gnyan rgya: mi nub rgya: kho bo gar dbang las rab rtsal gyis lcags bya lor sgrags kyi yang rdzong nas spyan drangs te/ shog ser ngos las dag par phab/ chu bya lor rgya grol lo/// / ༈ 'di'i brgyud pa snang mtha'/ tshe dpag med/ pad+ma 'byung gnas/ ye shes mtsho rgyal/ rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ shud bu dpal seng*/ dri med gling pa/ de sras gcen pad+ma bstan 'dzin/ gcung bstan pa'i nyi ma/ mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje/ kun bzang theg mchog rdo rje/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gzi brjid/ des so/// /
